# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-10-26 from the 2026-10-26 Hub dump.

- 3,185,642 models tracked, 906,371 declare a base model, 939,342 parent links, 89,330 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
